description: This header file 'UtilssyncPersistFile.h' defines utility functions within the 'Utils' namespace for file synchronization and JSON settings persistence. It provides inline functions to sync a file to disk and to persist JSON settings to a file, handling file operations and ensuring data is saved reliably.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the file specified by filename to disk by opening the file, flushing its buffers, and calling fsync.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON value under a specific key into a file, creating or updating the file as necessary, then synchronizes the file to disk.

ctags.name: persistJsonSettings
ctags.pattern: /^inline void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile, const string strKey, const JsonValue& jsVa/
ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
